components.name: Primary Button

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-action ds-vip">VIP</button> <button class="ds-btn-action ds-ok">OK</button> <button class="ds-btn-action ds-junk">Junk</button> <button class="ds-btn-action ds-review">Review</button>

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Non-committing action (Create Backup, Run Auto-Clean Now).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6eaf1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.43 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #0e1726); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline field; border turns ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6eaf1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #64748b); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Lists filter pill with a count; selected is filled ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #fff; color: var(--color-muted, #64748b); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6eaf1); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #0e1726); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: List Badge + Fragmented Marker
components.description: Tier-coloured list membership tags and the report-only fragmentation pill.
components.html: VIP · Dana CEO × OK · D. Chief × Fragmented
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 600 0.75rem/1.33 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-vip { background: var(--color-vip, #d97706); } .ds-badge-ok { background: var(--color-ok, #0f766e); } .ds-frag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 6px; background: rgb(245 158 11 / 0.2); color: #b45309; font: 700 0.75rem/1.33 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Settings Card
components.description: Hairline-bordered 16px-rounded container with an uppercase label header.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6eaf1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; max-width: 22rem; } .ds-card-h { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.43 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted, #64748b); } .ds-card-b { margin: 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Word-only tabs; weight alone marks the active tab.
components.html: TriageListsEventsReviewSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, #e6eaf1); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 8px 0; font: 400 0.75rem/1.33 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-muted, #64748b); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); } .ds-tab-on { color: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #0e1726); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Result of the last action, with Undo only when honestly reversible.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; max-width: 28rem; background: var(--color-ink, #0e1726); color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-toast-undo { background: none; border: none; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
Gmail Triage is one person's own sorting tool, not a product sold to strangers. It should feel the way a well-kept field notebook does: personal and used daily, with an order that reflects its owner. Each page holds plain records, and the marks on them carry meaning. The notebook is quiet so the marks can speak. In this app the marks are the four action colours, VIP, OK, Junk and Review, and everything around them steps back.

Density is high and calm. The owner triages in short, focused bursts, on the desktop at the keyboard and on an iPhone with one thumb, so screens favour many legible rows over generous whitespace. Type is small, sentence-case and set in the system face. Weight, not size, sets the hierarchy.

The notebook metaphor is the direction, and the current implementation only partly expresses it. Today's neutrals are cool slate, and the surfaces are plain white with hairline borders. Whether the notebook's warmth and tactility should reach the palette and surfaces is an open question, to be settled by the next critique, not assumed here. Depth is also under review (see Elevation & Depth).
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral chrome; colour is reserved for meaning.
Dense, compact rows and controls; small sentence-case type in the system face.
Weight (600) carries hierarchy, not large sizes.
Rounded but not soft: 8–16px corners on controls and cards, full pills for filters.
Every action has a labelled control; gestures and keys are accelerators.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each action colour means one decision and nothing else. VIP amber never decorates, and junk red appears only where something is removed. A colour that means two things means nothing.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: Navigation, cards, inputs and secondary buttons stay in ink, pencil grey, hairline and paper. If chrome needs colour to be found, the layout is wrong.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is 600 weight at body size. No size above 1.125rem appears in the app. A bigger heading is a sign the screen is doing too much.

dos: Do keep each action colour tied to its single meaning (The One Meaning Rule).
Do use 600 weight at 0.875rem for emphasis rather than a larger size.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairline borders and 8–16px radii, scaled to the element.
Do give every action a labelled control; swipes and arrow keys are accelerators only.
Do keep mobile primary actions at the bottom within thumb reach, respecting the safe-area inset.
donts: Don't use the Strasz Assessment Systems brand palette in this app (owner's decision, 2026-10-05).
Don't introduce a display font or headings larger than 1.125rem.
Don't use junk red for anything that does not remove something.
Don't add colour to chrome (nav, cards, inputs) to make it stand out.
Don't reference colour utilities that have no token. The desktop queue's `bg-tint` currently renders nothing, because no `tint` token is defined.
